name: ChromeKeycapButton
description: Glassmorphic industrial chrome keycap button featuring an event-driven 360-degree bezel glow sweep on hover or click, translucent frosted glass depth, pointer-tracking refraction sheen, dynamic 5x7 SVG dot-matrix legend, live Spacebar actuation, and mechanical switch audio.

checkpoints.name: v1: Initial AI Creation
checkpoints.description: Tactile industrial chrome keycap button featuring a multi-layered polished bezel, bead-blasted anodized aluminum cap, dynamic 5x7 SVG dot-matrix legend, live Spacebar actuation, and synthesized mechanical switch audio.
